name: Connexup
oneLiner: Restaurant growth platform combining commission-free online ordering, kiosk and QR ordering, loyalty, delivery app integration and AI review management.
bestFor: Independent and small restaurants, especially on Square POS, that want direct online ordering, loyalty and AI review replies from one vendor on a month-to-month plan.

updates.text: Released online ordering, followed by a self-ordering kiosk app (November 2025) and QR code ordering (December 2025), per its Product Hunt launch history.

features: AI replies to Google and Yelp reviews, with an option to auto-publish a reply when a review has gone unanswered for 72 hours
Post-visit review requests to grow review volume
Branded online ordering website without third-party commissions
Self-ordering kiosk and QR code table ordering
Menu optimization with upsell and cross-sell suggestions

pricing.text: Starter Suite from $149 per month with a 30-day free trial, month-to-month with no setup fee; Advanced and Custom plans priced by features. Its pages disagree on whether a 2.5% per-order commission applies.

notes: No named customers, press coverage or case studies found; G2 has only 3 reviews. The current review calls it a 'standalone reputation platform that works alongside whatever POS'; that is inaccurate: it is a broader restaurant ordering/growth platform and natively integrates only with Square (other POS on request). The current review's 'custom plans, contact sales' pricing is out of date: a $149/month Starter Suite is published. Dropped: Tripadvisor response support and 'SEO keywords and return-visit prompts' in replies (only Google and Yelp replies confirmed on the vendor's page). A separate site, connex-up.com, also describes a Connexup restaurant platform; relation unconfirmed.
